summary: Iteration 25 — Natal data sync feature E2E validated. Backend 6/6 PASS. Frontend: Saida overwrite, formulaire redirect, horoscope no-redirect, modal CRUD, localStorage resync, logout clear — all PASS. Two issues found: (1) HIGH — /mon-compte hard reload redirects to /connexion due to race condition; (2) MINOR — MonCompte.js calls non-existent /api/account/profile (404). Trial banner visible on /mon-compte.

minor.issue: birth_time stored & returned as HH:MM:SS while frontend sends HH:MM. localStorage gets '12:00:00' — legacy Horoscope/Tarot pages may not handle this. Recommend normalizing to HH:MM in /auth/me response.

ui_bugs.issue: Hard reload (page refresh) on /mon-compte kicks user back to /connexion. useEffect at line 373-375 does `if (!token) navigate('/connexion')` immediately before AuthContext finishes restoring session from Supabase getSession(). Must gate on `loading === false` from useAuth().

integration_issues.issue: chargerProfil() calls GET /api/account/profile which does NOT exist in backend (404). Backend only exposes /api/auth/me. Console always logs 'Erreur chargement profil'. The setProfil/setFidelite/setSubscription state stays null; some sections may render fallbacks but it's a wasted request + permanent error log.

action_items: Fix /mon-compte hard-reload redirect: import `loading` from useAuth() and only redirect when `!loading && !token` (MonCompte.js line 373-375).
Replace GET /api/account/profile with GET /api/auth/me in MonCompte.chargerProfil (or add /api/account/profile route in backend). Currently dead 404 call producing permanent console error.
(Optional) Normalize birth_time format: backend should return HH:MM (trim seconds) in /auth/me to match the frontend input format and legacy localStorage consumers.
critical_code_review_comments: MonCompte.js race condition (HIGH): useEffect navigate('/connexion') runs synchronously on first render when token is still null during AuthContext.getSession() hydration. Always gate on context.loading.
Backend birth_time format inconsistency: TIME column returns 'HH:MM:SS' from Postgres but frontend writes 'HH:MM'. Fix at serialization layer in /api/auth/me to return formatted 'HH:MM'.
MonCompte.js 386-398 references non-existent /api/account/profile — silent dead code path; either rename or implement the endpoint server-side.
AuthContext hydrateNatalLocalStorage stores `heureNaissance: user.birth_time` raw — if seconds suffix breaks AstrologyAPI input format, this would silently degrade Horoscope/Tarot data quality.

success_rate.frontend: 85% — 6/7 user flows pass; hard-reload regression on /mon-compte

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validations confirmed via SPA navigation (login → click navbar-mon-compte → click 'Mon Profil' link). The dropdown 'MON COMPTE' navbar testid opens a menu — to reach /mon-compte click 'Mon Profil' inside the dropdown. All 10 natal-modal data-testids are present and functional. Trial banner '7 JOURS d'essai gratuit Premium' shows on /mon-compte. The HARD-RELOAD bug is reproducible: login → navigate to /mon-compte via SPA → click browser refresh → kicked to /connexion. Backend /api/account/profile does NOT exist; only /api/auth/me.
rca of the issue: MonCompte.js line 373-375: `useEffect(() => { if (!token) navigate('/connexion'); }, [token])` triggers immediately when component mounts. On hard reload, AuthProvider's `supabase.auth.getSession()` is async — token starts as null then populates ~100-500ms later. The redirect fires before the token is restored. Fix: `const { token, loading } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (!loading && !token) navigate('/connexion'); }, [token, loading]);`
